items.title: Chevron (CVX) Plans Global LNG Expansion Across Four Continents
items.summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) outlined plans to expand its liquefied natural gas portfolio across Argentina, the East Mediterranean, Africa, and Australia. The producer is focusing on new LNG sources in multiple regions as Middle East supply disruptions affect global gas trade flows. Management is aiming to secure more diversified LNG volumes to support long term contracts with buyers in several international markets.
